_doc: Each fleet role: the program and model it starts with, and the files that become its system prompt (paths under this skill, or under the state folder when they start with $FLEET_HOME/; a missing file is skipped). `fleet exec <role>` reads this; `fleet roles` prints it. Change a role here, nowhere else. `{company}` in args is the folder under the work root (FLEET_WORK_ROOT, the folder holding .fleet) the agent works in. Logins live here too: Claude roles use the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from config.env, the reviewer the default Codex login (~/.codex), and cloud-agent the Devin account named by {company} (`devin-as`, the devin skill). Models: Opus for judgment and code, Haiku for read-only research, Sonnet for mechanical checks, and the reviewer from a different model family than the code's author.

cos.why: passes messages; low effort keeps the always-on agent cheap

lead.why: plans a project and judges its workers' results

tester.why: runs the app and captures screenshots

reviewer.why: a second model family reviews Claude's code

cloud-agent.why: long jobs that must survive the Mac going offline (it can hand off to Devin cloud); shepherding a PR until it lands
